reasons.latency_after_deploy: Deployment D-771 landed 14:20 and symptoms first appeared 14:31 (11 min later), so the rise most likely began after the checkout-api deploy, with residual timing uncertainty.
reasons.next_action: A fresh deploy of a new tax library is the strongest suspect, so rolling it back is the fastest way to restore latency; hotfixing is slowed by the active change freeze and other options address weaker hypotheses.
reasons.customer_impact: Latency tripled on checkout and six customers reported issues, but the error rate stayed at 0.2 percent, pointing to a moderate rather than severe impact.
